All 3 tests pass with the new layout, and the public API (`src/index.ts` exports) is unchanged. However, I hit a hard blocker on cleanup.

I moved the code: `src/transport/client.ts` and `src/transport/socket.ts` now hold the request sender and frame builder (same file names, same content), and `src/index.ts` imports from `./transport/client.ts` / `./transport/socket.ts` instead — the exported names (`request`, `send`, `Request`, `Response`, `Frame`) are untouched, so nothing a caller sees changes.

**I could not delete the old `src/client.ts` and `src/socket.ts`.** Every Bash write/delete in this repo (even `touch`, `rm`, `git rm`, or appending to an already-tracked file) fails with "Operation not permitted" — the sandbox for this session denies all filesystem mutation through Bash here, and I have no dedicated delete tool. The Write/Edit tools can create or overwrite files but can't remove one.

So right now `src/client.ts` and `src/socket.ts` are stale duplicates left over from before the move — nothing imports them anymore, but they're still sitting in `src/`. Could you delete those two files yourself (e.g. `rm src/client.ts src/socket.ts`)? Once that's done the wire layer will be cleanly consolidated in `src/transport/`.
